## Preserved API and semantics

Build(request,suite,sources) delegates the exact request to modelpatch.Execute,
extracts the accepted before token without surrounding whitespace, encodes the
accepted normalized candidate with jsonformat.Encode, then delegates candidate
project generation and verification to qualification. There is no second planner,
generator or evaluator. Preserve original resource ordering and errors.Is staging.
Suite bytes remain bounded but opaque; malformed/non-JSON/mismatched suites may
be packaged and verified unchanged, always unvalidated and unexecuted with binding
not inspected. Concurrent caller mutation remains unsupported.

Verify requires all six independent caller-held lowercase SHA-256 identities:
request bytes, before-token bytes, before semantic digest, normalized candidate
bytes, candidate semantic digest and suite bytes. It checks bounded canonical
outer/inner archives and exact inventories, compares actual payload identities
and outer/inner candidate equality, invokes native qualification.Verify, then
rebuilds and compares the complete outer bytes. Generic-verified inner payloads
remain domain-untrusted until native qualifier checks. Self-declared archive hashes
are not provenance. Successful verification is consistency only, authority none.

Execute retains strict mandatory fields, duplicate/unknown/null/union rejection,
canonical padded base64, resource checks before decoded bulk allocations and
finite limits. No automatic extraction, path access, process launching or network
is added. Only identifiable returned limit sentinels are mapped with errors.Is;
never infer hidden nested causes from error text.

## Prospectively bounded CLI and documentation repairs

CONTRACT, preserving the API/error/identity/opaque-suite boundaries above and adding
